title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico. See its path.
description: Hurricane Polo's intensity fluctuated between Category 4 and Category 5 — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast. Here's the latest on its path.
